summary: Tested admin/manager booking-override feature. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_override.py: 9/9 PASS — admin can DELETE another user's booking (200 + audit log notes admin), admin can PUT another user's booking to a date 3+ days in the future (skipping today/tomorrow restriction), admin edit skips the consecutive-day check, admin edit STILL enforces peak-hour 30-min restriction (returns 400 with 'peak' detail), regular user cannot DELETE or PUT another user's booking (403), GET /api/manage/bookings returns all bookings for admin, date_from/date_to filter works, regular user gets 403 on /manage/bookings. Frontend UI verified live: as admin on /staff, the Edit/Cancel override buttons render with correct data-testids (override-edit-{id}, override-cancel-{id}); clicking Edit opens BookingCalendar with a full <input type='date' data-testid='date-picker-override'> (today/tomorrow buttons hidden) plus the helper text 'Admin/Manager override — date restriction lifted.' confirming isAdminOverride detection works end-to-end. All 4 booking-feature regression tests from iteration_24 still PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/bookings.py is now ~666 lines (was 590) — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into bookings_user.py + bookings_staff.py + bookings_manage.py before adding more override flows.

edit_booking: when admin/manager overrides, the past-booking check is also skipped (line 354: `if booking_dt < now and not is_admin_or_manager`). PRD does not call this out — confirm whether admin should be allowed to edit a booking that already started/ended; probably fine for retroactive corrections but worth documenting.

edit_booking: when admin overrides a booking, _process_guests still runs against the admin's guest list — but the existing booking belongs to another user. The current implementation REPLACES guests with whatever the admin posted. If the admin omits the guests field, the owner's original guests are wiped. Consider preserving existing guests when the admin doesn't pass any, or showing a clear warning in the BookingCalendar override UI.

cancel_booking audit detail uses `Booking cancelled by {role} ({name})` (line 271) which doesn't match the edit override format `[Override by {role} {name}]`. Minor inconsistency in audit-log wording across the two endpoints.
/manage/bookings has no pagination — to_list(500) caps results silently. As bookings grow this will hide records. Add skip/limit query params or total count.
test_credentials: Inject-session pattern from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used prefix testtok_ for all temp tokens; cleaned up in fixture teardown and at session end. Test data prefixed TEST_ (TEST_overrideuser@example.com, TEST_other@example.com, TEST_otheredit@example.com, TEST_uiuser@example.com).
seed_data_creation: Temporary bookings owned by TEST_*@example.com on Sports Courts amenity were inserted directly into Mongo and auto-cleaned via autouse fixture before/after each test and at session teardown. No leftover data in DB after run (verified — deleted_count=1 final cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_25: Admin override feature fully working at API + UI. Regression suite is /app/backend/tests/test_admin_override.py + /app/backend/tests/test_booking_features.py. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_admin_override.py backend/tests/test_booking_features.py -v. Both require MongoDB access to inject sessions. Frontend route is /staff (not /clubhouse-staff). data-testids: override-edit-{bookingId}, override-cancel-{bookingId}, date-picker-override, date-today-btn, date-tomorrow-btn.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. All review-request scenarios pass.
